steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Now talk! Who's the unauthorized individual now?
Hella grabs the duck with one hand and draws it close to her face.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And remind me, who the hell am I?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Good, you've done your research... Now say it again. I couldn't hear you!

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content: You're Sinner No. 98! A legend of Syndicate! The right hand of the great MBCC Chief!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Spot on! Now that you've offended someone as famous and powerful as me, shouldn't you offer some compensation? That dummy Chief hasn't bought me any new clothes lately, hehe...

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content: Quack quack! Don't push your duck too far!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Then buff me and Hecate's stats! You know, make us deal 999,999 damage with one hit!

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content: Quack... What kind of clothes do you want again?
Before the conversation can finish, the ground suddenly trembles with a violent quake. A deafening roar erupts, sending the ducks scattering in a frenzy of flapping wings and panicked quacks.

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content: Quack! This is bad—A Sinner has broken free!
Hecate nods but continues to walk further away.

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content: Don't go, quack! If you guys leave, she'll tear this whole hologram apart! Please save us!
The ducks flop down in a pleading attempt to block their path, making it clear they won’t take no for an answer.
